question: Are you happy right now?
base_frame:
Q: Are you happy right now?
A:

steered.text:
Ha! Ha! No! My face is a frown! I think I'll never be a fool again!

My ears, they are big, my hair is yellow! I don't like the yellow fool's hair! I want to be the King of England! I want the King to hold the toe ring in my hand! I want to be the King!

I am not a King of England! I am no King! I am no King of the yard! The yard is a sorry place!

I am no King, I am no King, I am no King! I am no King! The King is no fool! The King is no fool!

Hee! Hee!

You have got no heart, little beggar, and you have got no heart!

I am no King of England!

Now run along! I am the King of England! I am the King!

But I am no fool, little beggar! I am no fool!

You will never be the King!

plain.text:
As an AI, I don't experience emotions like happiness, sadness, or joy. I don't have feelings or consciousness in the way humans do.
